info.title: Contact Form Email API
info.description: Internal API route for sending contact form emails via Brevo. This endpoint is consumed exclusively by the client-side contact form component and is not a public API.

servers.description: Same-origin API route (relative to the Next.js deployment)

post.summary: Send a contact form email via Brevo
post.description: Receives the visitor's email, subject, and message body. Validates, sanitizes, rate-limits, and forwards to the Brevo transactional email API. The visitor's email is set as replyTo; the sender and recipient are configured via environment variables.

400.description: Validation failed. One or more fields are missing, invalid, or exceed maximum length.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. The client IP has sent more than 5 requests in a 15-minute window.

example.error: Too many requests. Please try again later.

500.description: Internal server error. The Brevo API call failed, timed out, or the server is misconfigured. No internal details are exposed.

example.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

EmailRequest.description: The contact form submission payload sent from the client.

from.description: The visitor's email address. Must be a well-formed email ≤ 254 characters.

subject.description: The email subject line. Must be non-empty after trimming whitespace, ≤ 998 characters.

body.description: The plain-text message body. Must be non-empty after trimming whitespace, ≤ 10,000 characters.

ApiSuccessResponse.description: Returned when the email was successfully sent via Brevo.

ApiErrorResponse.description: Returned on any error condition. Never exposes internal details, API keys, or stack traces.

error.description: Human-readable error message safe for display to the end user.

fieldErrors.description: Map of field names to error messages. Present only on 400 validation errors.
